message.text: The project ships migrations for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite.

q02.
mysql, postgres, sqlite

Migrations live under `store/migration/`, with a dialect directory for each of those three (`store/migration/mysql`, `store/migration/postgres`, `store/migration/sqlite`). Each contains versioned SQL plus a `LATEST.sql`.
